args.prompt: Everything in heavy slow motion. Brownstone stoop at dawn: FAST dozing on SLOW's shoulder; SLOW awake, writing in his notebook; a faint shimmering 'Thinking…' text hovers above him. Camera: Medium, eye level. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, warm golden sunrise light, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
